decisions.text: type pie: fractions of the total are the message: a pie, which shows ½, ⅓ and ¼ at a glance and announces the whole (G1.36); once the facts above are given

findings.message: before a pie, the spec must say whether the values add up to a total someone would quote (G0.12): the numbers cannot tell, and a guess could misrepresent them (D-1)
findings.title: the meaningful-total check before a pie, stacked chart or treemap

findings.message: before a pie, the spec must say whether every part of the total is shown (G0.13): the numbers cannot tell, and a guess could misrepresent them (D-1)
findings.title: the all-parts check before a pie, stacked chart or treemap

findings.message: before a pie, the spec must say whether any part contains or overlaps another (G0.14): the numbers cannot tell, and a guess could misrepresent them (D-1)
findings.supply: data.parts.overlap false, or the pairs in data.parts.overlaps ([part, parent])
findings.title: the overlap check: disjoint parts before a pie, stacked chart or treemap

source.shows: the same request without the parts' facts: whether the values add up, whether every part is shown and whether a part contains another cannot be read from the numbers, so all three are asked for before any pie (D-1; overlap by the owner's decision of 1 Oct 2026)
